svg.aria-label: Entity-relationship diagram of the store. One scenario run owns many observations, quarantined records, detection findings, evidence bundles and anomalies; the anomalies table was created in the first migration and is never written. One evidence bundle has many hypotheses, which are appended and never replaced; one hypothesis has many analyst verdicts. A bundle's evidence cites observation rows by identifier, resolved before the bundle is stored, without a foreign key.
svg.text: one run, many rows; deleting a run deletes its rows
evidence cites observation rows by id, resolved before the bundle is stored; no foreign key
PK primary key; FK foreign key
